mapper.select: SELECT count(*) practice_count,coalesce(sum(r.total_count),0) total_count,coalesce(sum(r.answered_count),0) answered_count,coalesce(sum(r.correct_count),0) correct_count,coalesce(sum(r.wrong_count),0) wrong_count,coalesce(sum(r.unanswered_count),0) unanswered_count,coalesce(sum(r.short_answer_count),0) short_answer_count,coalesce(sum(r.duration_seconds),0) duration_seconds FROM practice_result r JOIN practice_session s ON s.id=r.session_id WHERE

SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE i.self_assessment IS NOT NULL) rated,count(*) FILTER(WHERE i.self_assessment='CORRECT') correct,count(*) FILTER(WHERE i.self_assessment='WRONG') wrong FROM practice_item i JOIN practice_session s ON s.id=i.session_id WHERE

SELECT (s.submitted_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS "day",count(*) practice_count,sum(r.answered_count) answered_count,sum(r.correct_count) correct_count,sum(r.correct_count+r.wrong_count) objective_answered_count,sum(r.duration_seconds) duration_seconds FROM practice_result r JOIN practice_session s ON s.id=r.session_id WHERE GROUP BY "day" ORDER BY "day"
mapper.sql: FROM facts f JOIN totals t ON t.question_id=f.question_id JOIN question q ON q.id=f.question_id JOIN question_revision r ON r.id=q.current_revision_id JOIN question_bank b ON b.id=q.bank_id JOIN subject s ON s.id=b.subject_id WHERE f.rn=1 AND t.wrong_count>0AND f.judgment='WRONG' AND f.judgment='CORRECT' AND q.bank_id=#{bankId}
